name: Hydrated lime (80% Ca(OH)2)
restrictions: cao_pct is the CaO equivalent of 80% Ca(OH)2 (x 56.077/74.093); fast-reacting, do not mix directly with ammonium fertilizers

name: Dolomitic lime (55% CaCO3 + 33% MgCO3)
restrictions: oxide equivalents of the carbonates (CaCO3 x 56.077/100.087; MgCO3 x 40.304/84.314); the magnesium carrier of the combination

name: Paz del Rio slag amendment (48% CaO + 1.2% MgO + 10% P2O5)
restrictions: also supplies 10% P2O5, which this schema does not model - that phosphorus is NOT counted anywhere in the fertility plan and arrives on top of it
